## Verified resolution

Fixed in local ES commit `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`, included in clean qualified final source `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. [Published source-overlay evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-cloud-validator/ui/README.md) provides rejected/original and corrected frames, exact source/build/catalog hashes, passing checks, independent review and canonical CF01–CF15 references. #508 now explicitly tracks this exact source for integration and pin promotion; its body was read back before this closure. This closes the verified draft-source defect, not the parent integration/firmware/public-adoption gate. Accepted firmware and the installed handheld remain unchanged.

## Observed defect

Root reviewed the actual CF14 French frame `walk-fr1280-scan-retry-options/frames/03-selected-empty-systems.png`. The selected library is empty while the synthetic provider has a populated OtherLibrary/ROMs/gb outside that selection. The headline says no system in the player's cloud contains the selected content. GuiMenu.cpp's restore branch currently uses `NO SYSTEM IN YOUR CLOUD HOLDS WHAT YOU TICKED.` This overstates the scope after #508 removes account-root discovery. Source behavior correctly stays inside the selected root; the copy must say that too.

Already written: this is local draft source/overlay proof. No accepted firmware, product pin or personal cloud is changed. Preserve the original frame as rejected semantic-copy evidence even though the scoped read and pointer-preservation controls passed.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Reuse the current empty selected root plus populated out-of-scope synthetic library. No new provider, physical action or whole-suite rerun is needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The empty restore headline explicitly scopes its finding to the selected cloud folder, in English and French; it does not claim an account-wide search or absence.
- [x] Adjacent setup guidance is accurate for the categories that reach this branch, including BIOS/game-content boundaries; it does not direct unrelated file types into the wrong folder or silently change selection.
- [x] Source/catalog checks and actual corrected frame review pass with exact committed source identity. The empty-selected/populated-unselected fixture retains all original file hashes and independent pointers.
- [x] CF14 canonical flow and screenshot index link the corrected evidence and preserve the rejected original before completion/pin promotion.

Source/proof and final review completed; remaining product integration is tracked in #508. This remains inside #508/#510 qualification before #507. #513 fit changes are separate and remain valid for their tested source.
title: M7.P5: Scope empty-library guidance to the selected cloud folder
